title: An antagonistically pleiotropic gene regulates vertebrate growth, maturity, and lifespan
reason: Paper reports bulk RNA-seq data from vgll3 mutant and wildtype killifish at multiple time points, deposited in GEO (GSE226279, GSE300596). Also reanalyzes existing single-cell data from ref. 44. While the study involves multi-sample comparisons (e.g., mutant vs WT, different ages), the primary data is bulk RNA-seq, not scRNA-seq, and the analysis does not explicitly address batch correction or cross-dataset integration. However, the data could be used for integration with other killifish datasets if overlapping cell types are available.
methods_summary: Genetic perturbation of vgll3 in killifish (Nothobranchius furzeri) via CRISPR; bulk RNA-seq transcriptomic profiling of gonads and other tissues; single-cell analysis of gonadal cell types from previously published data; smFISH and cellular assays.
